run_protocol.note: Match frozen V2 development protocol; do not use the 5k interactive demo protocol for the final external test.

seed_aggregation: mean of seeds 42/43/44 per held-out dataset/framework before ground-truth ranking
ground_truth_definition: (held-out dataset, predeclared preference profile) -> observed ranking of five frameworks from 3-seed aggregated outcomes under the frozen V2 ranking rule
prediction_definition: held-out dataset meta-profile -> frozen V2 predictions -> same frozen ranking rule
research_integrity_rules: Do not inspect held-out outcomes before the protocol is frozen.
Do not modify or retrain V2 after viewing held-out results.
Use all three seeds for primary ground truth; do not cherry-pick per-metric seeds.
Report the held-out result even if it is worse than development validation.
